comments: The tool covers the RGAA 4.1.2 criteria that can be tested automatically. The list of covered criteria is published at https://ouzom.fr/audit/criteres-rgaa/ and the method at https://ouzom.fr/audit/methodologie/. The interface is in French.
features: Free online pre-audit of one web page against the French RGAA accessibility standard (based on WCAG 2.1) and the RGESN ecodesign standard. Runs automated checks (axe-core, W3C HTML validator, keyboard and focus tests), gives two scores out of 100 and emails a detailed report that lists what still needs manual review.
title: Ouzom free page analyser (RGAA / RGESN)
